from.place: The proof clause invoking Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 20.26.9 (Stacks Tag 06YD): the stalk of each flat sheaf module is a flat module.

title: Stalks of flat sheaves are flat modules
statement: Let (X,\mathcal O_X) be a ringed space and let \mathcal F be a flat \mathcal O_X-module sheaf [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], meaning that tensoring with \mathcal F preserves short exact sequences of \mathcal O_X-modules. For every point x of X, the stalk \mathcal F_x is a flat module over the local ring \mathcal O_{X,x}, meaning that tensoring with \mathcal F_x preserves exact sequences of \mathcal O_{X,x}-modules.
